lines.text: Nvidia just made one hundred fifteen point eight billion dollars, in three months.
That's more than double a year ago.
But here's what most people miss.
One hundred seven point six billion dollars came from one business. Data centers.
That's about ninety-three percent of everything Nvidia sells.
Gaming, PCs, cars and robots, combined? Just eight point two billion.
And about seventy-five cents of every sales dollar is gross profit.
Next quarter, Nvidia expects one hundred thirty billion dollars.
Without counting a single dollar of China data center sales.
